source.note: Kenney ambulance (FBX like car-sedan, car-van, car-delivery and the other kit cars, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). Real size: height 2.6 m with the light bar, like a Japanese high-roof ambulance (Toyota Himedic about 2.5 m, Mercedes Sprinter ambulance 2.6-2.8 m), to stand with the tractor, the fire truck and the 1.7 m characters. That gives 4.69 m long and 2.17 m wide: Kenney's toy proportions are stubby (length 1.8 x height against about 2.2 x on a real one, which is 5.6-6 m long and 1.9-2.0 m wide), so height is the matched dimension and the van comes out about 1 m short and 0.2 m wide. Matching the length instead would need 3.1 m height and 2.6 m width. Recoloured as a Japanese ambulance: Kenney's red lower body is white (paper, with the warm sky shade), the waistline band is the accent-red stripe, and the blue light bars are red; ink-dark windows and wheels. White with a red stripe keeps it apart from the black/white police car, the light-blue van and the white/red delivery truck (red cab, no stripe). maxColors 32 is the split where the side stripe is one clean cluster; the colour map's gradient still puts a stripe-red triangle on the roof and thin dark slivers on the rear doors. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
